# Read Primitives — Count Star

```{tags} reference, query-template, read_primitives
```

> [Read Primitives](../../read-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Read Primitives queries](index.md)

Metadata-based count optimization vs full table scan

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
/* metadata-based count optimization vs full table scan performance */
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_lineitems
FROM lineitem
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def count_star_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """Metadata-based count optimization vs full table scan performance."""
    return ctx.get_table("lineitem").select(ctx.col("l_orderkey").count().alias("total_lineitems"))
```
